title: A generic pair and a max helper
description:
Write small generic types and methods.

```
Pair: (Ada, 36) swapped: (36, Ada)
Max of 3, 9, 4: 9
Max of pear, apple, plum: plum
Max of nothing: no items
```
hints: Take an enumerator: `using var e = items.GetEnumerator(); if (!e.MoveNext()) throw ...; T best = e.Current;`, then keep looping.
requirements: `record Pair<A, B>(A First, B Second)` with `Swap()` returning `Pair<B, A>`.
`T Max<T>(IEnumerable<T> items) where T : IComparable<T>` throws `InvalidOperationException("no items")` for an empty list.
stretch: Add `MaxBy<T, K>(items, Func<T, K> key)` that compares by a key.
